## Overview

**Bot Studio** is a sleek, browser-based development workspace crafted specifically for the Telegram Bot API. Effortlessly search methods, construct robust request payloads using auto-generated dynamic forms or visual builders for nested types (such as inline keyboards, media, and entities), and execute live test calls directly to Telegram.

Everything runs natively in your browser: your bot token is used exclusively to call `https://api.telegram.org` directly, ensuring it is never stored, tracked, or sent anywhere else.

## Features

* **Comprehensive Method Explorer:** Instant search and deep browsing across the entire Telegram Bot API method list.
* **Smart Parameter Builder:** Build complex requests via auto-generated forms alongside an interactive visual builder for nested and union types.
* **Live Two-Way Sync:** Keep form inputs and raw request JSON seamlessly synchronized whether you edit the UI or modify the code directly.
* **Direct-to-API Testing:** Send requests straight from your browser environment and deeply inspect server responses in real time.
* **Automated Sync Engine:** Hourly checks for upstream Telegram documentation updates ensure your local schema remains perpetually up to date.

<img src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/73097560/115834477-dbab4500-a447-11eb-908a-139a6edaec5c.gif" width="100%">

## Security & Privacy

* **Zero Backend Storage:** Your API credentials never touch a remote server database.
* **Direct CORS Communication:** All requests route strictly from your client environment to Telegram's official endpoints.
